full_model.reason: FULL failed the predeclared strict uniqueness rule in both directions. It did not beat every simple baseline in matched-count evaluation in both 2024 and 2025.

upgrade_rank_cross.interpretation: For L1 upgrades, the relation between L1 rank and market rank is more stable than the full feature stack.

downgrade_gap_only.interpretation: For L1 downgrades, disagreement magnitude alone is extremely stable across the two unknown years.

model_global_metrics.y2024: All augmented models, including FULL, were slightly worse than MARKET_ONLY in log-loss/Brier.
model_global_metrics.y2025: FULL improved over MARKET_ONLY; simpler models did not.
model_global_metrics.conclusion: Global incremental information is not stable across years.

architecture: Core L1 remains market-free. No reranking. No FULL Dissent promotion.
next_recommended_test: Build a deliberately simple asymmetric dissent layer: UP uses rank-cross only; DOWN uses gap-only. Freeze thresholds from prior calibration and evaluate strict walk-forward without FULL features.
